snippet.title: War for Athelay - Preview Trailer
snippet.description:
Itch.io page with download: https://noblephantomgames.itch.io/war-for-athelay

An initial trailer for War for Athelay, a turn-based strategy game where you send units into procedurally generated arenas to fight enemy units. Initially we are planning to release the game on PC in mid 2020 with the hope of releasing on the Switch (and possibly other systems) sometime after. Visit https://noblephantomgames.itch.io/war-for-athelay to learn more.

Music: https://www.purple-planet.com
Background Image from CraftPix.net

Website: noblephantomgames.com
Contact: noblephantomgames@gmail.com
